name: book-workflow
description: Run a UI-first local book workflow that ingests books, preserves them end to end, and generates book-specific skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build end-to-end book pipelines from plain-English requests.
interface.longDescription: Resolve a book path from a UI request, ingest it if needed, extract notes, generate summaries, validate the local artifacts, and scaffold a book-specific coach skill.
defaultPrompt: Let's create an end to end pipeline for this book.
Prepare this book for querying and coaching.
Refresh the preserved artifacts and coach skill for this book.
